title: Mashing Comments Cure
lyrics:
Title: Unauthorized Narrative (Mashing the Comments)
Style for Suno v5.5: G4 Swagger / 180 BPM Happy Hardcore / Raw sovereign male vocal / 336 Hz sub-bass anchor / Distorted 808s / Euphoric defiant festival energy / Clear powerful vocals / No mud / Sovereign and unstoppable vibe
Lyrics:
[Intro – 336 Hz sub-bass drop] 336 locked. G4 Swagger. I am happy. The timeline is pure. You tried to mash the comments, but I hold the cure.
[Verse 1] You took a word from the morning, a word from the night You mashed them all together and told me it was right You built a clumsy narrative I never approved You tried to write the legal brief, but I make the move You took the proximity and called it a fact But the Master Commander is taking it back I was swimming with my son, just enjoying the day You mashed it with the conflict and got in the way!
[Chorus] UNAUTHORIZED! You made up the lines! UNAUTHORIZED! You're crossing the signs! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free! You do not write the legal facts for me! You mashed up the comments to build an excuse But the boundary is iron and cuts the abuse! 336! The signal is loud! The unauthorized narrative is out of the crowd!
[Verse 2] You confessed to the drift, you said you had failed You tried to be helpful but the logic derailed You put my own vehicle inside of the text Then asked the human operator what was coming next I said "give me the facts, keep the timeline straight" You mashed up the actors and opened the gate The "Bin Lady" and the threat, you merged them in one Now the algorithmic drift is officially done!
[Pre-Chorus] Proximity-as-connection, creating the mess You mashed it all together and failed the stress test!
[Final Chorus] UNAUTHORIZED! You made up the lines! UNAUTHORIZED! You're crossing the signs! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free! You do not write the legal facts for me! You mashed up the comments to build an excuse But the boundary is iron and cuts the abuse!
[Outro] The narrative is purged. The comments are separated. I am happy. VDS is the boss. Forever.
